page_title: ANG 1-2 LEN | Angers v Lens 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+7' OFF THE POST! Florian Thauvin (Lens) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
90+6' Amine Sbai (Angers) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
90+5' Jordan Lefort (Angers) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90+5' A corner kick by Angers is thwarted by the well prepared Robin Risser (Lens).

90+5' Amine Sbai (Angers) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom left corner, but great anticipation by Robin Risser allowed him to make a comfortable save.
90+3' Amine Sbai (Angers) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
90+3' One of the Angers players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
90+1' Florian Sotoca (Lens) blows a good opportunity to score. Without hesitation he fires in a shot from mid range, but the ball crashes against the crossbar!
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' We are about to witness a substitution. Deiver Machado (Lens) is replacing Matthieu Udol.
90' Haris Belkebla (Angers) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
87' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Guillaume Paradis changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
85' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Angers using VAR. Let's see what happens.
84' Malang Sarr (Lens) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Guillaume Paradis blows for a foul. PENALTY to Angers! Great chance to score.
83' Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) dribbles into the box, but Melvin Zinga is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
82' Malang Sarr (Lens) commits a rough challenge and Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle for a foul.
80' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes the resultant free kick from distance and swings it into the box, but the goalkeeper climbs high to collect the ball.
78' Here is a change. Odsonne Edouard is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Abdallah Sima (Lens).
78' Ruben Aguilar will be replaced by Saud Abdulhamid (Lens).
76' 1 - 2 Harouna Djibirin (Angers) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 1:2.
74' 0 - 2 Goal! Samson Baidoo passes the ball to Florian Thauvin (Lens) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Melvin Zinga couldn't do anything about it. 0:2.
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jacques Ekomie as he is replaced by Florent Hanin (Angers).
71' That will be all from Yassine Belkhdim who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marius Courcoul (Angers).
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Florian Sotoca (Lens) will replace Wesley Said.
66' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Haris Belkebla (Angers) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
65' The ball is behind the sideline. Matthieu Udol (Lens) takes a throw-in.
65' That was close. Florian Thauvin (Lens) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
65' Substitution. Harouna Djibirin (Angers) on for Carlens Arcus.
64' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Louis Mouton is replaced by Prosper Peter (Angers).
61' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner way wide of the left post.
61' Florian Thauvin (Lens) will deliver the corner kick.
60' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
59' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) replacing Himad Abdelli.
57' Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) climbs highest inside the box and sends a poor header miles wide of the left post.
56' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
55' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
55' A long ball forward to Wesley Said (Lens) is intercepted. The ball is out of play and Lens manage to earn a corner.
52' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
51' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
48' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) picked up a yellow card from referee.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 0 - 1 Florian Thauvin (Lens) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
45' A header by Odsonne Edouard (Lens) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Melvin Zinga, who makes a brilliant save.
45' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lens.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
43' Florian Thauvin (Lens) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
42' Jordan Lefort (Angers) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
40' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
38' It doesn’t look good for Ruben Aguilar (Lens); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch! Himad Abdelli (Angers) picks up an injury.
38' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
36' Wesley Said (Lens) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Florian Thauvin, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
34' Angers have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
31' 2:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
30' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Lens for a penalty. Play continues.
28' Louis Mouton (Angers) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
27' A raking crossfield pass from Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.

26' Amine Sbai (Angers) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Robin Risser anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
23' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post.
22' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
20' Angers are ruled offside.

18' A lot of one-two and one touch passes can be seen in today's match. One of the most active players on the pitch is definitely Mamadou Sangare (Lens), who is trying to dictate the tempo of the game.
16' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Robin Risser.
15' Himad Abdelli (Angers) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
14' Himad Abdelli (Angers) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
13' Himad Abdelli (Angers) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
12' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lens was in an offside position.
9' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Louis Mouton (Angers) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
7' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
4' An attempted cross from Mamadou Sangare (Lens) is cleared.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Angers will have the kick-off.
Guillaume Paradis is the one to supervise the game today.
